subject.title: Telegram /reasoning stream can leave replies stuck after send_attempt_started and chat.history burst

question: Should this stay as distinct Telegram `/reasoning stream` plus `chat.history` recovery work, or be folded into the broader Telegram guarded-lane recovery work?
rationale: The source evidence supports a shared ambiguous-send recovery gap, but this report adds a reasoning-preview trigger and Control UI history pressure that the broader guarded-lane issue does not fully own.

options.title: Track distinct reasoning/history work
options.body: Keep this issue open as the place to prove and fix reasoning preview/final delivery and decide whether `chat.history` needs debouncing or backpressure.

options.title: Fold into Telegram recovery
options.body: Treat the reasoning and history details as symptoms and track remaining recovery behavior through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/91456 after preserving this evidence there.

options.title: Split UI history separately
options.body: Use this issue for Telegram ambiguous-send recovery and create or select a separate item if maintainers want `chat.history` latency owned independently.

recommendation.title: Track distinct reasoning/history work
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the place to prove and fix reasoning preview/final delivery and decide whether `chat.history` needs debouncing or backpressure.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest current-main and merged-PR history signal across the recovery guard, Telegram capability surface, and reasoning-preview boundary.
